meta.title: Atlas of Global Energy
meta.subtitle: An illustrative map of major oil, gas and LNG projects
meta.disclaimer: Sample dataset — figures are illustrative and not real-world fact.

projects.name: North Field East Expansion
projects.description: A flagship liquefaction expansion adding four new megatrains to one of the world's largest LNG hubs, lifting national export capacity in a single phase.

projects.name: Ras Laffan Refinery III
projects.description: A condensate splitter complex producing naphtha, jet fuel and gasoil from North Field feedstock for regional and export markets.

projects.name: Barzan Gas Plant
projects.description: An onshore processing facility supplying domestic power and industry, recovering ethane and liquids from offshore North Field gas.

projects.name: Al Shaheen Offshore Field
projects.description: A mature offshore oil field developed across multiple platforms, among the country's largest producing crude assets.

projects.name: Sabine Pass LNG
projects.description: One of the first large-scale US export terminals, with six trains converting Gulf Coast shale gas into LNG for global delivery.

projects.name: Permian Basin Gas Hub
projects.description: A cluster of cryogenic processing plants gathering associated gas from prolific shale oil production across the basin.

projects.name: Baytown Refinery
projects.description: An integrated refining and chemical complex on the Gulf Coast, among the largest in the Americas by crude throughput.

projects.name: Mad Dog Phase 2
projects.description: A deepwater platform tapping a large oil reservoir via subsea wells in the central Gulf of Mexico.

projects.name: Plaquemines LNG
projects.description: A modular liquefaction project on the Mississippi River designed for rapid phased start-up of export trains.

projects.name: Gorgon LNG
projects.description: A three-train liquefaction project paired with one of the world's largest carbon capture and storage operations.

projects.name: Ichthys Offshore Field
projects.description: A long-distance subsea-to-shore development piping gas hundreds of kilometres to an onshore liquefaction plant near Darwin.

projects.name: North West Shelf Gas Plant
projects.description: Australia's foundational gas venture, processing offshore production for both export and domestic supply for decades.

projects.name: Scarborough Development
projects.description: A deepwater gas field feeding an expanded onshore train via a new export trunkline.

projects.name: Bonny Island NLNG
projects.description: West Africa's anchor LNG complex, with a major seventh train under development to lift export capacity further.

projects.name: Dangote Refinery
projects.description: A single-train mega refinery built to make the country a net exporter of refined products rather than crude.

projects.name: Egina Offshore Field
projects.description: A deepwater field produced through a large FPSO vessel moored 150 km off the coast.

projects.name: Oben Gas Plant
projects.description: An onshore processing hub central to domestic gas-to-power supply across the southern grid.

projects.name: Johan Sverdrup Field
projects.description: A giant field powered from shore by renewable electricity, among the largest oil developments on the Norwegian shelf.

projects.name: Troll Gas Field
projects.description: A cornerstone of European gas supply, produced from one of the largest offshore gas accumulations in the region.

projects.name: Hammerfest LNG (Melkøya)
projects.description: Europe's northernmost LNG plant, liquefying gas piped from the Snøhvit field in the Barents Sea.

projects.name: Mongstad Refinery
projects.description: Norway's largest refinery and a key crude terminal on the country's west coast.

projects.name: Ghawar Oil Field
projects.description: The largest conventional onshore oil field ever developed, the long-running backbone of national production.

projects.name: Jafurah Gas Development
projects.description: An unconventional gas megaproject built to grow domestic gas supply and feed petrochemical expansion.

projects.name: Jazan Refinery
projects.description: An integrated refining and power complex on the Red Sea coast serving domestic demand and exports.

projects.name: Safaniya Offshore Field
projects.description: The world's largest offshore oil field, producing heavy crude from shallow Gulf waters for decades.

projects.name: LNG Canada
projects.description: Canada's first large export terminal, shipping West Coast gas to Asian markets via a shorter Pacific route.

projects.name: Hibernia Offshore Field
projects.description: A gravity-base platform engineered to withstand iceberg impact in the harsh North Atlantic.

projects.name: Athabasca Oil Sands
projects.description: A vast unconventional resource producing upgraded synthetic crude from mined and in-situ bitumen.

projects.name: Edmonton Refinery Hub
projects.description: A cluster of refineries processing oil-sands and conventional crude for the western Canadian market.

projects.name: Das Island LNG
projects.description: One of the earliest LNG export plants in the world, processing associated gas from offshore fields.

projects.name: Ruwais Refinery
projects.description: A major integrated refining and chemicals complex anchoring a coastal industrial city.

projects.name: Upper Zakum Field
projects.description: A giant offshore field developed using artificial islands to lower long-term drilling costs.

projects.name: Hail & Ghasha Gas
projects.description: A sour-gas megaproject paired with carbon capture, aimed at gas self-sufficiency.
